from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # Find the one-row solid divider, compare the two panels cell by cell,
    # and use 3 for agreement and the panels' common background for disagreement.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                if len(set(row)) == 1 and counts[row[0]] == len(row))
    top, bottom = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    bg = Counter(v for row in top + bottom for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if a == b else bg for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
